stage_name_zh: 阶段 2：准确表达、一词多义辨析与时序/AI 基础句法（Day 26–50）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 27 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G014】情态动词、确定性梯度与科学谨慎表达（Epistemic Hedging）；【G020】语态的语篇决策：基于研究对象、旧信息前置与施事责任的主动/被动选择。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP021】具身智能（Embodied AI）与机器人：空间表征、轨迹跟踪与物理约束，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 情态动词、确定性梯度与科学谨慎表达（Epistemic Hedging）
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 科学写作要求结论的语气强度与实验/数据证据的完备度严格对齐。通过情态动词（may, might, can, could）、认知副词（arguably, apparently, plausibly, relatively, typically）及谨慎动词（suggest, indicate, point to, appear to）控制断言边界。
rules: 当存在未测混杂（unmeasured confounding）、小样本或仿真环境限制时，必须使用 may be attributable to / suggests that / supports a tentative conclusion。
禁止在经验研究中滥用 irrefutable, undeniable, inevitable, universal, conclusively prove；只有经核实的数学反例推翻全称命题时才可用 disprove / irrefutable。
examples: The observed discrepancy may be attributable to differences in measurement procedures.
A distributional forecast is arguably more informative when decisions depend on tail risk.
The verified counterexample provides irrefutable evidence that the universal mathematical claim is false.
common_errors: 在改写或总结时删去原句的 may / arguably / in this sample 等限定词，造成过度绝对化。

grammar_instruction.name: 语态的语篇决策：基于研究对象、旧信息前置与施事责任的主动/被动选择
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 破除“被动语态一定比主动语态更学术”的迷思。语态选择服务于：(1) 维持句间话题链连贯（把上句提到的受事对象作为本句被动主语，满足 Given-before-New），(2) 明确谁对设计决策或核验承担责任。
rules: 当描述标准化数据清洗、传感器部署或客观流程，且受事对象是段落主题时，选用被动语态（The records are arranged in chronological order before the time-series analysis）。
当阐述本文核心创新设计、范围限定决策或强调多名标注者独立操作时，选用主动语态（We confine the analysis to...; Two analysts analysed the data independently; The algorithm exploits the sparsity of the matrix）。
examples: Passive for topic continuity: The predictions are compared with ground-truth labels that were checked by two annotators.
Active for clear methodological agency: We reformulate the constrained problem as an equivalent optimization problem.
common_errors: 通篇机械使用被动语态导致语句冗长、施事责任模糊（如分不清是前人文献做的还是本文做的）。

grammar_instruction.name: 去除“AI 味（Anti-AI-ese）”与过度修辞：用具体机制、指标与实例替代空洞夸张
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 典型 AI 生成文本充斥着空洞的套话与浮夸副词/形容词（如 delve into, testament to, tapestry, underscores the paramount importance, revolutionize, unparalleled, groundbreaking），却缺乏具体技术细节。地道顶会论文（NeurIPS/ICLR/CoRL）与高分雅思/托福/六级写作追求“低修辞密度、高信息密度”：用具体动词、明确指标和真实实例说话。
rules: 删除无实质信息的“清嗓子”套话（Throat-clearing）：少用 *It is worth noting that / It is undeniable that / In the realm of modern artificial intelligence*，直接陈述事实主干。

禁止“只有夸张形容词而不给实例或数据支撑”：不要写 *The model achieves an enormous, unparalleled improvement*，而要写 *The proposed parametrization reduces MSE by 8.4% relative to the seasonal naive baseline on hourly electricity demand*。
优先选用朴素、精准的单音节或核心学术动词（examine, test, compare, constrain, decompose, bound, mitigate）替代故作高深的修辞词。
examples:
AI 腔/空洞夸张：*This groundbreaking paradigm delves into the intricate tapestry of temporal dynamics and achieves unparalleled accuracy.*
地道学术改写：*This model decomposes the series into trend and seasonal components, achieving lower forecasting error than the linear baseline on three benchmarks.*

六级/雅思空洞句：*Technology has an enormous impact on education in many ways.*
地道具体展开：*Asynchronous learning platforms allow part-time students to review lecture recordings at their own pace, reducing scheduling conflicts.*
common_errors: 堆砌 paramount, unprecedented, revolutionize, multifaceted 等宣传式词汇，违反客观学术语域。
只下宏大判断（如 *This method is very efficient*）而不给出具体的计算复杂度、内存占用或延迟数据。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 具身智能（Embodied AI）与机器人：空间表征、轨迹跟踪与物理约束
expression_pattern_instruction.template: To bridge the discrepancy between simulation and real-world deployment, the policy enforces [physical/monotonicity constraints] while adapting to [sensor noise / external perturbations].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于具身智能、机器人控制与视觉导航写作，准确表达仿真到真实迁移（sim-to-real）、空间方位（spatial orientation）与速度/运动学约束。
examples: The optimization procedure enforces a non-negativity constraint on the weights while tracking the trajectory.
The sensitivity analysis examines the effect of a small perturbation to the input sensor readings.
common_errors: 把仿真器（simulation）中的理想合成观测（synthetic data）直接等同于真实物理传感器的含噪观测。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 客观归属文献观点或档案记录来源
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 准确区分外部文献说法与本文实证判断。
examples: According to the authors, the evaluation uses synthetic sentences.
According to the records, the event began before sunset.
common_errors: *According to me（第一人称严禁使用）。
